mapper.sql: select u.user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, p.student_no, p.user_category, cs.term_id, cs.class_id, c.class_name, p.major_id, m.major_name, p.grade_year, u.phonenumber, u.status, p.source, u.create_time from sys_user u join edu_user_profile p on p.user_id = u.user_id left join edu_class_student cs on cs.user_id = u.user_id and cs.is_current = '1' left join edu_class c on c.class_id = cs.class_id left join edu_major m on m.major_id = p.major_id
mapper.select: select count(1) from edu_user_profile where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into edu_user_profile (user_id, user_category, student_no, major_id, grade_year, source, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{userCategory}, #{studentNo}, #{majorId}, #{gradeYear}, #{source}, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.select: select user_id from edu_user_profile where student_no = #{studentNo} limit 1
mapper.update: update edu_class_student set is_current = '0', leave_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId} and is_current = '1' and term_id = #{termId}
mapper.insert: insert into edu_class_student (class_id, user_id, term_id, join_time, is_current, create_by, create_time) values (#{classId}, #{userId}, #{termId}, sysdate(), '1', #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select count(1) from edu_class_student where user_id = #{userId} and is_current = '1'
